mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and increasing liquidity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.0%) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering economic distress signals that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) and declining payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0%) signals severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, elevated housing starts (HOUST > 850 thousand units) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) signals a tightening labor market and rising consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales growth (RSAFS growth > 0.5%) indicates strong consumer spending and economic momentum, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
